_comment: Researched answers for the 66 lemmas that had no plural in the Wiktionary extract. Sources are the Arabic dictionaries aggregated by arabdict.com (معجم اللغة العربية المعاصرة، المعجم الوسيط، مختار الصحاح، لسان العرب، تاج العروس، الرائد، المحيط في اللغة). 'none' means the word has no plural of its own: it is a collective, an already-plural form, a maṣdar, a dual, an elative or a proper name.
